title: Pricing agreement: Ridgeway Clinics
content:
Supply agreement between Harborline Industrial Supply and Ridgeway Clinics, effective 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30.
GLV-NIT-M, nitrile gloves M, case: $44.00 per case. A volume price of $40.00 per case applies only to a single order of 1,000 cases or more.
GLV-NIT-L, nitrile gloves L, case: $46.00 per case.
Prices exclude freight. Items not listed are billed at list price.
